title.narrative: Standards and Market Access Programme for Kenya's animal and plant-based products

description.narrative: The overall objective of the Standards and Market Access Programme (SMAP) is to enhance market access and competitiveness of Kenya#s animal and plant-based products, through greater adoption of relevant international standards and improved regulation and enforcement in the country. A sub project is proposed to support the completion of the ongoing EU Kenya SMAP project in the face of limitation in implementation beyond the implementation period, allowed by EU financial regulations.
